dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Ah, it's been a long time since I was last at Qingce Village. Little Liu, Daddy misses you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is everything alright?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, traveler. Thanks for your concern. Nothing's wrong. I just... miss my daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I told her that once this shift ended, I'd take leave to spend some time with her for a few days at Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: But who knew that such a huge thing would suddenly happen in Liyue Harbor. Not only was every soldier on leave recalled, but everyone at their post has also had their leave canceled.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Now we have to man our stations all day. Forget taking leave, I need to find someone who can take over my post even if I want to get a sip of water.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I'd prepared my gifts, too — a huge bag of toys... But what shall I do with it now?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: That's right! Traveler, could I ask you to bring these toys to my daughter, Little Liu? She stays at Qingce Village. If you ask Granny Ruoxin, you're sure to find her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lay it on me.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you, thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other matters to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Alright. Qingce Village is such a long way off, anyway. I should think of another solution rather than trouble you...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: It's just like they say — no matter how hard you work, there's always more to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Now that the crisis has passed, things in the city have been gradually returning to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I thought that we might be able to take it a little easier once it was all over.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Little did I know that on top of our usual guard duty and other day-to-day work, they'd have us helping out in other departments from time to time, too...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: All these little things add up to mean that we're actually busier than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I was called to help collect and organize some incoming paperwork, and then I had to patrol the city and settle an escort request from a merchant caravan...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* And on top of all that... Just a few days ago, we received a report that there have been intermittent earthquakes near Nantianmen. We've sent someone to investigate, but they found everything to be completely normal.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: That doesn't mean we can afford to lower our guard though — this is an earthquake we're talking about. So, we are still sending people to check on the area every so often.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, however, we're very short-handed at the moment... Traveler, if you have the time, would you mind heading over to Nantianmen and taking a look for me?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Thank you very much. *sigh* I must be off, duty calls...

choices.text: What am I supposed to be looking for?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Good question... if I had to guess, I'd say probably... monsters, or something.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: As for the earthquakes... No one we've sent so far has encountered anything of the sort. So, maybe the person who initially reported it was just getting confused.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Well, I shall leave the matter of Nantianmen to you. Ugh, I'm already running late for my next assignment...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Ah, traveler! It's you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You have to see this picture of my daughter, she looks so adorable...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: "While rock stays hard, the mountain shall never fail; while the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail." We are the Millelith — Protectors of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I'm a soldier, proud to be serving with the Millelith in defense of this great city of Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...I say that. But I'd still rather be working closer to Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: That's where my beloved daughter is. I think about her constantly...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Her name's Little Liu. My wife sadly passed away in childbirth, so it's the grandparents who look after her now.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: She's still very young. I haven't a clue how to explain this to her... So I just lie, and say that her mother has always been working in Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* I haven't seen her in a good long while since coming to Liyue on my own for work. The last time I held her in my arms, she was nowhere close to the weight of this polearm...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Is she eating her dinner?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Is she in good health?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Is she making lots of nice friends?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Liu... Your daddy misses you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Bye, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Do me a favor if you ever pass through Qingce Village, would you? Ask for Little Liu and tell her that her daddy's doing just fine, and that he'll come to visit as soon as he can... and that's a promise...
